name: llm-cost-router
description: Sends easy prompts to cheap models and hard prompts to expensive models, with cost tracking, budgets, escalation and failover.
author: Udisha Singh

llmRouter.models.markdownDescription: Models to route between. Leave empty to use the defaults (Claude Haiku 5.5 → Sonnet 5.5 → Opus 5.5). Each entry needs `id`, `tier` (`cheap`, `balanced` or `premium`), `provider` (`anthropic` or `openai-compatible`), `model`, `inputPricePerMTok` and `outputPricePerMTok`. See the README for examples.

id.description: Short unique name, also usable as an inline override (@id).

model.description: Model name sent to the provider API.

baseUrl.description: API base URL (for openai-compatible providers, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1).

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable to read the key from if none is saved.

effort.description: Anthropic effort level for this model.

llmRouter.thresholds.balanced.description: Difficulty score at or above which prompts go to the balanced tier.

llmRouter.thresholds.premium.description: Difficulty score at or above which prompts go to the premium tier.

llmRouter.dailyBudgetUsd.description: Daily spend cap in USD. When the next request would go over it, the router uses the cheap tier. 0 turns it off.

llmRouter.escalateOnLowConfidence.description: If the answer is empty or sounds unsure, retry on the next tier up.

llmRouter.failover.description: If a model errors (rate limit, outage, missing key), try another configured model.

llmRouter.maxOutputTokens.description: Default max output tokens per request.

llmRouter.systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt sent with every request.

llmRouter.showRoutingNotification.description: Show which model a prompt was routed to in the status bar.
